instructions: Does this test assert observable production behaviour so that a plausible regression would fail it? Judge the assertions and implementation provided, independently of whether the test name promises additional behaviour. Focused smoke tests can be meaningful. Do not penalise missing unrelated cases. Use insufficient_context if relevant implementation or fixtures are unavailable.

criteria.meaningful: At least one meaningful production behaviour is verified by assertions sensitive to a plausible regression.
criteria.weak: Assertions are tautological, only check incidental structure, or would pass if the intended production behaviour were broken.
criteria.insufficient_context: Missing implementation or fixtures prevent judging the assertions.
